snippet.title: WHY DID MICHAEL JACKSON SAY HIS CHILDHOOD WAS TAKEN AWAY?
snippet.description:
Here is your complete pack for *WHY DID MICHAEL JACKSON SAY HIS CHILDHOOD WAS TAKEN AWAY* - with no angled brackets anywhere.

### 1. YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION

WHY DID MICHAEL JACKSON SAY HIS CHILDHOOD WAS TAKEN AWAY?

He said it himself, in his own words, three times, in three different decades.

Oprah Winfrey, Feb 10, 1993, Neverland Ranch, 90 million viewers, first interview in 14 years:
People wonder why I always have children around. It is because I find the thing that I never had through them. Disneyland, amusement parks, arcade games, I adore all that stuff because when I was little, it was always work, work, work.

Oxford University, March 7, 2001, Heal The Kids speech:
My childhood was completely taken away from me. There was no Christmas, there were no birthdays, it was not a normal childhood, nor the normal pleasures of childhood. Those were exchanged for hard work, struggle and pain and eventually material and professional success. But as an awful price, I cannot re-create that part of my life.

Dancing The Dream, 1992, book, poems and essays:
I totally identify with Peter Pan, the lost boy from Never Neverland.

That is why he said it. Not for sympathy. Not for PR. Because, in his words, he never got to be a child.

Michael Joseph Jackson, born Aug 29, 1958 in Gary, Indiana, died June 25, 2009 in Los Angeles, age 50, cardiac arrest caused by acute propofol intoxication, per coroner.

Eighth of 10 children, fifth of 9 who lived to adulthood, of Joseph Walter Jackson, born July 26, 1928 in Fountain Hill, Arkansas, died June 27, 2018 in Las Vegas, age 89, steelworker and part time musician, and Katherine Esther Scruse Jackson, born May 4, 1930 in Barbour County, Alabama, now 96 in 2026, devout Jehovah's Witness, clarinet and piano.

Family: 230 Jackson Street, Gary, Indiana, 2 bedroom house, 11 people, one bathroom, no garage, no backyard. Parents, 9 children, plus relatives.

Brothers and sisters: Rebbie, born May 29, 1950, now 76, Jackie, born May 4, 1951, now 75, Tito, born Oct 15, 1953, died Sept 15, 2024, age 70, Jermaine, born Dec 11, 1954, now 71, La Toya, born May 29, 1956, now 70, Marlon, born March 12, 1957, now 69, Brandon, twin of Marlon, died at birth March 12, 1957, Michael, born Aug 29, 1958, Randy, born Oct 29, 1961, now 65, Janet, born May 16, 1966, now 60.

King of Pop, Thriller, 1982, best selling album of all time, 70 million copies, Bad, 1987, Dangerous, 1991, HIStory, 1995, Invincible, 2001, 13 Grammy Awards, 26 American Music Awards, 400 million records sold, per Guinness World Records.

Marriages: 2. Lisa Marie Presley, 1994 to 1996, Debbie Rowe, 1996 to 2000, divorced 1999 per some sources, 2000 per others. Children: 3, Prince, born Feb 13, 1997, now 29, Paris, born April 3, 1998, now 28, Bigi, born Feb 21, 2002, now 24, via surrogate.

Here are the 7 reasons he gave, in his own interviews, books, and speeches.

REASON 1: HE STARTED WORKING AT AGE 5, NOT AGE 18

Michael joined Jackson Brothers in 1964, age 5, playing congas and tambourine, backing Jackie, Tito, Jermaine. By 1965, age 6, lead singer, with Marlon, age 8.

Jackson 5, 1964 to 1975, Motown, 1969 to 1975, signed at age 10, Michael age 11 when first single I Want You Back hit No. 1, Jan 1970.

Michael to Oprah, 1993: I would do my schooling which was three hours with a tutor and right after that I would go to the recording studio and record, and I would record for hours and hours until it is time to go to sleep. And I remember going to the record studio and there was a park across the street and I would see all the children playing and I would cry because it would make me sad that I would have to work instead.

School: 3 hours a day, with tutor, on tour, in studio, in hotel. No classroom. No recess. No school friends. No field trips. No prom. No graduation.

Work: 5 hours rehearsal after school every day, per Joe Jackson to Time, 1984: He claimed to have trained the children for several hours every day for three years before they began to perform publicly.

By age 11, Michael had performed in more nightclubs than most adults perform in a lifetime.

Michael to Gold Magazine, 2002: I grew up onstage. I grew up in nightclubs. When I was seven, eight years old I was in nightclubs.

REASON 2: NO CHRISTMAS, NO BIRTHDAYS, NO NORMAL PLEASURES

Oxford, 2001: There was no Christmas, there were no birthdays, it was not a normal childhood, nor the normal pleasures of childhood.

Why: Jehovah's Witness faith, Katherine Jackson, devout. Jehovah's Witnesses do not celebrate Christmas, birthdays, Halloween, Easter, or other holidays, because they believe they are pagan, and only God should be worshipped.

Michael to Oprah, 1993: We were Jehovah's Witnesses, we did not celebrate Christmas.

Also: Work schedule. Jackson 5 toured on Christmas, on birthdays, on New Year's Eve, on holidays. No time off.

Michael to Martin Bashir, Living With Michael Jackson, 2003: I never had a birthday party. I never had a Christmas tree.
